answers.rationale: The requirement specifies medium voltage switchgear with a 15 kV rating and metal-clad construction. The CROWN-ARMV product matches this description as it is arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers, suitable for 15 kV applications.
The requirement specifies that transformers and meters are provided by the utility. This is not a product requirement for SpinCo, as the equipment is supplied by others.

The requirement describes a sequence of operation for tie breakers in a medium voltage switchgear system. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable for this application as it includes medium voltage switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers, which can be configured to meet the specified operational requirements.
The requirement specifies that cable is provided by the utility and terminations are by the contractor. This is not a product requirement for SpinCo, as the work is performed by others.
